page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 32 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance utilizes dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU allocation provides 32 physical cores with a single thread per core, running on a KVM hypervisor to ensure dedicated compute resources without hyper-threading overhead.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Additionally, the ecs.r6.8xlarge does not feature GPU acceleration, making it unsuitable for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning training.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core positions this instance as a resource-dense option for memory-bound applications. It is designed for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.
